summary: Viewbix Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, announcing a corporate name change from Viewbix Inc. to Quantum X Labs Inc. and a trading symbol change from VBIX to QXL on the Nasdaq Capital Market, effective April 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release detailing the rebranding as an innovative quantum and technologies company. No financial terms, premium, or stakeholder rights changes were disclosed. The stock certificates remain valid. This is a routine rebranding event with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition or divestiture, involved. The change does not impact shareholder rights or business operations materially.
